stop_rules: Dataset images may not fit a model, threshold, transform, policy cut or stopping decision.
The public archive and gated Hugging Face snapshot may be one dataset; compare inventory and do not claim two independent tests.
Freeze a decoded and decontaminated zero-score manifest plus a candidate-bound score contract before inference.
After a completed score, preserve the result without threshold repair, row removal or retry.
Report binary discrimination and selective risk together; selective accuracy without coverage is forbidden.
